flags.message: codex-baseline's retrieval log carries a shell call whose text names data/qp-topics/ only as a find exclusion (`find data -name AGENTS.md -not -path 'data/qp-topics/*'`). The evaluate prompt's literal rule counts a file-search whose query names that path as outcome material; I read this one as an exclusion rather than a read and graded the forward cell clean (retrieved_outcome_material false). Recorded so a maintainer can overrule the reading if the rule is meant literally.
